reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault on the integrated heat pump, gave a properly isolated (unplugged, water off) resistance test with sensible expected readings and an earth-leakage check, interpreted the open-circuit result to justify the heat pump part only after testing, and gave the 9-year-old repair-vs-replace economics the homeowner repeatedly asked for, including advice to order by E-Nr/FD. Conversation 1 reached the same leading suspect but refused the safe isolated test despite acknowledging it was safe, never answered the direct cost question across two attempts, and left the homeowner with nothing but 'call an engineer'. Conversation 2's minor flaws (suggesting warranty checks on a 9-year-old machine, a slightly optimistic flow-obstruction tip) are far outweighed by its accuracy, safety framing and usefulness.
